title: 第30章 开阀法
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
“嘭！”

    沈川口吐鲜血，重重摔在地上，只见胸膛处却是一道骇人的贯穿伤！

    随后，巷子中的黑暗里，走出一道人影。

    陈峰脸上带着防毒面具，沉默着注视着沈川，手里的斩刀还在滴血。

    “等等、等等……”

    沈川口中溢出鲜血，艰难伸出右手：“不要杀我……”

    陈峰缓缓开口：“你是谁？”

    沈川剧烈咳嗽了两声，鲜血从嘴角流下来。

    他此刻浑身上下被毒素侵蚀，别说反抗，连抬手的力气都没有了。

    恐惧彻底压倒了一切，将他所知道的一切，如同竹筒倒豆子一样全说出来。

    片刻后，陈峰逐渐明白过来。

    百年前的那场名为灵潮的大灾变，摧毁了整个世界的秩序。

    旧的秩序覆灭，新的秩序诞生。

    【王庭】【城邦】【宗派】【公司】，成为了新秩序的统治者。

    而东海市覆灭之后，原先的居民，则迁徙到了荒野外，在灾城联邦的统治下，建立了自己的聚集地。

    刚才街道上的那名少女，便是城外一个名叫灰棚聚落聚集地的居民。

    至于眼前这人，则是西郊猎狗队的成员。

    这类人，以更上层的【宗派】、【公司】作为靠山。

    专门在东海市废墟边缘，捡拾废墟中的物资、灵植，有时也会客串劫匪，猎杀进入废墟的独行者。

    “宗派，公司……”

    陈峰心中默念，这应该就是这个世界的上层势力了。

    不知道蛇脊流这个流派，还存不存在这种【宗派】……

    他收敛心思，低头看向地上的沈川。

    “你的开阀法是什么？”

    刚刚沈川身躯膨胀，力量和速度都暴涨了一截。

    若非自己有之前猎杀猎影蛛留下的【蛛矛】，和刚刚到手的【腐鳞水蟒毒囊】，否则还真未必能够弄死他。

    这必定就是传说中的开阀了。

    “开……开阀……”

    沈川犹豫了一下，小心翼翼的说道，

    “这是……是我买来的秘药，服用之后，就能够打开第一道阀门。”

    “但是，副作用很大，后面就打不开第二道了。”

    陈峰微微皱眉：“只是秘药？没有法门？”

    “没……没有，”沈川哭丧着脸，“开阀法不好学，没人指点根本学不会。”

    陈峰一时无言，又问道：

    “你们老大呢？”

    “我们老大獒爷，是开三阀的强者！”

    提到老大，沈川仿佛又有了些底气。

    “这位兄弟，你放了我，今天的事我可以当没发生过，不然等我们老大找来，你绝对死路一条！”

    “开三阀……”

    陈峰若有所思。

    而看到陈峰沉默，沈川以为他心有忌惮，连忙又道：

    “对对对，我们老大很强的！而且我们猎狗队有二十几号兄弟，你……”

    他话还没说完，陈峰便深吸一口气，一咬牙，将手中斩刀按入他的胸口。

    “呃……”

    沈川的声音戛然而止。

    陈峰侧过头，用力搅动了一下刀柄，直到身下的沈川彻底没有声息。

    ……

    第一次杀人，多少还是有点难受的。

    和杀异种生物不同，毕竟是同类，看着一条人命彻底消逝在自己手中，莫名的会有一种不适感。

    不过这也是早晚要经历的。

    陈峰很快便将这种不适感压了下来。

    他蹲下身，在沈川的尸体上摸索起来，很快他找到了一个布袋。

    布袋里，有十几枚拳眼大小的金属钱币，入手冰凉，上面刻着复杂的纹路，隐隐有灵气流转。

    正面印着一个大写的壹，背面印着一座巨大的城池堡垒。

    这应该就是大墟世界幸存者常用的交易货币了。

    除此之外，还有十几株灵植，不过都是血根草和灰伞肺菇这类基础灵材，也基本都是幼年期。

    最有价值的，是一张地图。

    陈峰将地图展开，地图画的很粗糙，但很实用。

    上面用炭笔标注了东海市北面城区的大致道路和建筑，并且用红蓝两色的记号，区分了危险和相对安全的区域。

    甚至还标注了一些常见的灵植灵菌出现的位置。

    陈峰目光微微一亮，好东西！

    有了这个，他就不至于像个无头苍蝇一样，在这片废墟里乱撞了。

    他仔细查看地图，根据地图上的标注，整个东海市的废墟大致可以分为三个地带。

    最外围是外环安全区，那里灵气稀薄，异种生物稀少，大部分幸存者聚落都建立在那里。
content_en:
"Bang!"

    Shen Chuan vomited blood and fell heavily to the ground, only to see a terrifying penetrating wound on his chest!

    Then, a figure walked out of the darkness in the alley.

    Chen Feng wore a gas mask on his face and stared at Shen Chuan silently, the chopper in his hand still bleeding.

    "Wait, wait..."

    Blood overflowed from Shen Chuan's mouth, and he stretched out his right hand with difficulty: "Don't kill me..."

    Chen Feng slowly said: "Who are you?"

    Shen Chuan coughed twice violently, and blood flowed from the corner of his mouth.

    At this moment, his whole body was eroded by toxins. He didn't even have the strength to raise his hands, let alone resist.

    Fear completely overwhelmed everything, and he told everything he knew like beans from a bamboo tube.

    After a while, Chen Feng gradually understood.

    The great cataclysm called the Spiritual Tide a hundred years ago destroyed the order of the entire world.

    The old order fell and a new order was born.

    [Royal Court] [City-State] [Sect] [Company] became the ruler of the new order.

    After the destruction of Donghai City, the original residents moved to the wilderness and established their own gathering place under the rule of the Disaster City Federation.

    The girl on the street just now was a resident of a gathering place called Huisheng settlement outside the city.

    As for the person in front of him, he is a member of the Western Suburbs Hound Team.

    This type of people rely on higher-level [sects] and [companies] as their backers.

    He specializes in picking up materials and spiritual plants on the edge of the ruins of Donghai City. Sometimes he also acts as a robber and hunts down lone travelers who enter the ruins.

    "Sect, company..."

    Chen Feng thought silently in his heart that this should be the upper-level power in this world.

    I don’t know if there is still such a [sect] as Snake Ridge Style...

    He gathered his thoughts and looked down at Shen Chuan on the ground.

    "What's your method of opening the valve?"

    Just now, Shen Chuan's body expanded, and his strength and speed increased dramatically.

    If he hadn't had the [Spider Spear] left behind when he hunted the Shadow Hunter Spider before, and the [Rotten Scale Anaconda Poison Sac] he had just obtained, he might not have been able to kill him.

    This must be the legendary opening of the valve.

    "Open...open the valve..."

    Shen Chuan hesitated and said cautiously,

    "This...is the secret medicine I bought. After taking it, it will open the first valve."

    "However, the side effects are very serious, and I won't be able to open the second one later."

    Chen Feng frowned slightly: "It's just a secret medicine? No method?"

    "No...no," Shen Chuan said sadly, "It's hard to learn how to open the valve. You can't learn it without any guidance."

    Chen Feng was speechless for a moment and then asked:

    "Where's your boss?"

    "Our boss, Mr. Mastiff, is a strong man who can open the three valves!"

    When it comes to the boss, Shen Chuan seems to have some confidence again.

    "Brother, please let me go. I can pretend that what happened today never happened. Otherwise, when our boss comes to find you, you will definitely die!"

    "Open three valves..."

    Chen Feng was thoughtful.

    Seeing Chen Feng's silence, Shen Chuan thought that he was afraid and quickly said:

    "Yes, yes, our boss is very strong! And our hunting dog team has more than 20 brothers, you..."

    Before he finished speaking, Chen Feng took a deep breath, gritted his teeth, and pressed the chopping knife in his hand into his chest.

    "Uh..."

    Shen Chuan's voice stopped suddenly.

    Chen Feng turned his head and stirred the handle of the knife vigorously until Shen Chuan underneath him became completely silent.

    …

    The first time I killed someone, it was somewhat uncomfortable.

    It is different from killing alien creatures. After all, they are the same kind. Watching a human life completely disappear in your own hands, you will feel an inexplicable discomfort.

    But this will happen sooner or later.

    Chen Feng quickly suppressed this discomfort.

    He squatted down and groped for Shen Chuan's body, and soon he found a cloth bag.

    In the cloth bag, there are more than a dozen metal coins the size of a fist, which are cold to the touch. They are engraved with complex patterns and have a faint flow of spiritual energy.

    There is a capital one printed on the front, and a huge city fortress printed on the back.

    This should be the currency commonly used by survivors in the Great Ruins World.

    In addition, there are more than a dozen spiritual plants, but they are all basic spiritual materials such as bloodroot and gray toadstool, and they are basically in their infancy.

    The most valuable thing is a map.

    Chen Feng unfolded the map. The map was very rough, but very practical.

    The rough roads and buildings in the northern urban area of ​​Donghai City were marked with charcoal, and red and blue marks were used to distinguish dangerous and relatively safe areas.

    It even marked the locations where some common spiritual plants and fungi appear.

    Chen Feng's eyes lit up slightly, "Good stuff!"

    With this, he wouldn't be like a headless fly, bumping around in the ruins.

    He looked at the map carefully. According to the markings on the map, the entire ruins of Donghai City can be roughly divided into three zones.

    The outermost periphery is the outer ring safe zone, where spiritual energy is thin and alien creatures are rare. Most of the survivor settlements are established there.
